Similarly, the interim image and blue component are encrypted into the final gray scale ciphertext with stationary white noise distribution, which has camouflage property to some extent. In the process of encryption and decryption, three different groups of fractional orders, five private phase functions and one common phase function are used as keys to enhance the security of the proposed system. Additionally, the proposed iterative fractional Fourier transform algorithm has faster convergent speed. Simulation results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: An Access Control Mechanism Based on Active Domain
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In the traditional access control mechanism, it is hard to record and control the course of reading and writing. The confidentiality is destroyed by the abnormal reading out, and the integrity is lost by the abnormal writing in. And so many threats come from Internet applications in recent years. The question is how to trigger the control the reading and writing in time. We present the concept of active domain, and it is created for each visit. Our approach is to build an access control mechanism and polices based on active domain. (1) It triggers the system to create active domain for a program it the beginning of running. (2) The reading or writing or communicating trigger the checking for the validity and consistency between the action and the active domain. If it exits abnormal action, the control layer based on active domain would end the visit on time. For the mechanism, we built triggering and system mechanism and the rules. The real-time triggering and control mechanism strengthen the safety and security of the system.

articleTitle: Design of Control Software for Automobile Engine Test Stand Based on VB
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Automobile engine test stand uses electric eddy current machine to simulate road running mode on automobile engine loading. The VB-based control software of the automobile engine test stand can achieve functionalities including load control, data acquisition and having the measurement data stored in the Access database so as to facilitate data query and the dynamic display of the power waveform. The data communication is realized by serial communication between measurement node and host computer. The software's friendly interface, easy usage has played an important role in analysis of the engine's power dynamic characteristics. The design and implementation method of the software is specified in the paper.

articleTitle: Complementarity Analysis of Affine Region Detectors
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Complementarity benefiting from combination of affine region detectors for image matching is examined closely. Possible combinations of five types of representative affine region detectors are integrated into the test. The complementary features and region sizes are analyzed by the means of specific instances for the first time. To objectively compare the performance of combination detectors, the matching score is used as an evaluation criterion, which reflects not only the number of correct matches, but also the ratio between correct matches and mismatches. GLOH descriptor is used for all combinations. It is observed that HA+HE, E+HE, HE+M and M+E outperform other combinational detectors in most cases.

articleTitle: A Method Based on FPGA of Long Distance and High Speed Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In current communication system, data transmission is high-speed and long-distance. The interface of low-voltage differential signaling (LVDS) becomes the first choice of data transmission. The most widely used is the LVDS differential chip. But this chip is often more expensive, the cost of development will be increased. Therefore, this paper presents a way to reduce cost. we use the software Quartus which produced by ALTERA company to call the macro module ALTLVDS to replace LVDS chip. In this way not only do we get the correct result, but also reduce the cost of the design.

articleTitle: Proving Program Termination by Discoverer and Complete Discrimination System
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Combined with the tools DISCOVERER and CDS, a method is presented to synthesize ranking functions of loop programs. It is shown that the problems of finding ranking functions can be converted to a simpler problem, which can be solved by the complete discrimination system of polynomials (CDS), when DISCOVERER generates only one condition.

articleTitle: SPUM: A Screen Partition Update Method for Embedded Multi-Window Systems
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a screen partition update method (SPUM) for embedded multi-window systems with the purpose of improving their display performance. In this method the whole screen is partitioned into multiple independent sub-regions according to the position and size information of application windows at first and the overlap degree of each sub-region is calculated afterwards. Each window has an associated bitmap used to mark which sub-regions on the whole screen are contained by this window and which are not. When one application window updates, sub-regions of this window are updated step by step. In order to reduce the probability of conflict, the free sub-region with bigger overlap degree is updated preferentially. This method increases the probability of parallel update. When we apply the SPUM algorithm into an actual DirectFB graphics system, the total window update time cost is reduced by 35% and the conflict number is decreased by 72% in our experiment. Further experiment shows that with the increase of refresh rate the performance improvement introduced by the algorithm is more notable.

articleTitle: XenDebugger: A Source Level Kernel Debugger on Xen Virtualization
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: As the operating system is getting larger and more complex, debugging on OS (Operating System) is difficult and time-consuming. Existing OS debugging tools are not source level kernel debugger. In this paper the XenDebugger is presented as a source level kernel debugger, which is based on Xen virtualization. The debug info will be written into a file when compiling kernel. The XenDebugger uses the Xen interface to run the debugged kernel as guest OS. It decodes the debug info and then set the kernel running step by step. We evaluate the performance to verify its feasibility. The result shows that the XenDebugger is accurately to locate the reason to the problem. The XenDebugger is accepted by Xen community as an open source project.

articleTitle: Nonexistences of the Packing and Covering Designs for the Join Graph of K1 and C4 with a Pendent Edge

abstract: Let λK<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sub> be the complete multigraph with v vertices. A G-design G-GD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">λ</sub>(v) of λK<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sub> is a pair (X,B), where X is the vertex set of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sub> and B is a collection of subgraphs of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sub>, called blocks, such that each block is isomorphic to and any two distinct vertices in G are joined in K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sub> exact(at most, at least) l blocks of B. articleTitle: A Clustering Approach to Improving Pseudo-Relevance Feedback: Improving Retrieval Effetiveness by Removing Noisy Documents
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Pseudo relevance feedback is an effective technique for improving retrieval results, which assumes a small number of top-ranked documents in the initial retrieval results are relevant and selects from these documents related terms to the query to improve the query representation through query expansion. However, these documents are often a mixture of relevant and irrelevant documents. The relevance feedback is quite effective and performs significantly better than pseudo-relevance feedback, which needs the user explicitly provides information on relevant documents to a query. This paper makes a case for the use of query-specific density clustering in IR on the grounds of improved retrieval effectiveness in a fully automatic manner and without relevance information provided by human and the experimental results show that significant improvements can be obtained on several collections when our new model FWN (Feedback Without Noise) is used.

articleTitle: A Petri-Net Model for Formal Modeling of WS-BPEL Processes
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Business Process Execution Language (WS-BPEL) is one of the most popular standards for Web service composition. To formalize WS-BPEL gives the way to further describe, reason, analyze and verify complex service compositions. In this paper, we propose a translation-based approach for formalization of WS-BPEL processes, which employs the Petri net as the intermediate representation. A set of translation rules is defined for constructs and activities so that processes specified in BPEL can be translated into the equivalent Petri nets.

articleTitle: IT Boundary-Spanning Capability Promotes Business Process Reengineering: Haier Case
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper takes Haier as a case to analyze how IT boundary-spanning capability promotes BPR. In terms of the case analysis, this study has great theoretical value for exploring an evolutionary process of IT boundary-spanning capability promoting BPR. With its findings, this study also contributes to practical value on how boundary spanners form IT boundary-spanning capability, and then break through internal and external boundary obstacles for making BPR succeed.

articleTitle: Study of Mass Customization in Cluster Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Cluster supply chain is a new kind of supply chain. This paper first put forward the origin of cluster supply chain, then explored attributes of cluster supply chain compared with the traditional chain, at last gave feature of mass customization in cluster supply chain. It is proved that the advantages in cluster supply chain system derive from multitude hierarchical and functional driving levels. Factors such as quantity, important degree of offered items and convenient degree of obtained items illustrate that cooperation styles in supply chain would not only have one, so it makes sense that multi-style cooperation exists in cluster supply chain. The detailed discussion was developed in the paper.

articleTitle: A Method of Predicting News Update Time Combining Exponential Smoothing and Naive Bayes
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: The time of web page update appears to be erratic, how the user can fast access to valuable information has become one of the hot spots. From the view of application, we can use mathematical models to forecast the update time of news reports, although it can not be completely accurate. In this paper, we proposed a combined predict algorithm for news update. Firstly, we applied the Exponential Smoothing method to our dataset. Secondly, we leveraged the Naive Bayes Model for prediction. Finally, we combined two methods for Combination Forecasting. Through the experiments, we show that Combination Forecasting method outperforms other methods while estimating localized rate of updates.

articleTitle: Intelligent Mobile Robots Localization System Combined ZigBee and Distributed Microphone Array
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: A mobile robot localization design scheme combined ZigBee and distributed microphone array is introduced. Firstly, the frame of localization system composed of eight-element microphones array, two ZigBee point to point communications modules are proposed. Secondly, generalized cross-correlation (GCC) function based on time delay of arrival (TDOA) is introduced to the system design. In order to improve the localization effect, the PHAT transform function is used synchronously in the system. Otherwise, to increase the distance between two microphones for improving space resolution and avoiding signal frequency aliasing, broadband frequency-continue-changed audio is selected as the sound source. Thirdly, ZigBee technology based on CC2430 chip is used in the design scheme, it is used to encrypt localization result and exchange data between microphone array and mobile robot. The data is transmitted conveniently and safely using the Zig-Bee technology. Finally, Experiments were performed. The experiment results show that the design can calculate the position of the sound source accurately, it takes less than 1.5 seconds to locate the position of the sound source for each data, it is faster than that based on high resolution spectral estimation.

articleTitle: A Simulation Study on the Developing Locus of Commercial Housing Market in Xi'an
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In order to point out a road of sustainable development of commercial housing market in Xi'an, In this paper, the SD model handling nonlinear advantage is used to simulate the 2012-2015 Xi'an commercial housing demand, supply and price trends, And successfully pointed out that the development path of Xi'an commercial housing market. This paper exceeds other articles lies in the use of affect factors rate to simulate its impact of the size of the price, supply and demand ratio, and identify the degree of the impact of the key factors.

articleTitle: Design of Miniature Camera Lens Including Diffractive Optical Elements
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To meet the demand for miniature camera lens, in this paper, there designed a new type of miniature plastic lens, which is made up of three lenses. The second surface of the first lens is designed as a diffractive surface. The diffractive lens is used to eliminate aberration. There has investigated the primary aberration about the systems expressed by PWC. The function relation among P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>, W<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>, C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>, and the diffractive lens structure have been established. These three lens materials are 'PMMAO', 'P-CARBO' and 'PMMAO'. The F-number is 2. 4 and FOV is 50°. The overall length of this optical system is 6.52mm. The MTF at 250lp/mm is higher than 0. 3.

articleTitle: Binary Keypoint Descriptor for Accelerated Matching
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Efficient extraction of key points from images is a hot topic in computer vision and forms many applications. We propose a kind of binary descriptor which is invariant to rotation, viewpoint change, blur change, brightness change, and JPEG compression. To best address the whole process, this paper covers key point detection, description and matching. Orientations of the interest points are estimated by the Haar-wavelet responses to achieve rotation invariance. Binary descriptors are computed by comparing the intensities of two points in the overlapping sampling pattern on image patches. At last, binary descriptors are matched by Hamming distance which can be done very fast on SSE instruction set of modern CPUs such as Core i7 processor. We use coarse-to-fine strategy to accelerate the matching of key point. In the experiment results, we will show that our descriptor is fast and robust.

articleTitle: An Approach of Memory Mapping Intuition Inversion about Criminal Reasoning System
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: On purpose of improving the research in artificial intuition system (AIS) when the information in hand is not sufficient, a learning model of memory mapping intuition discovered (MMID) based on experience process is presented, and poses a skeleton of intuitive reasoning. Through the relationship construction of practical intuitive model and on-the-spot model, it sets up a couple of mapping models intuitive information acquisition. The study shows that the premise of intuitive reasoning is to set up patterns of memory mapping intuition inversion (MMII). The paper proposed the basic principles of experience or study and intuition sub-optimum selection from the single of human perception behavior.

articleTitle: A Bayesian Network Based Intelligent Plant Classification System
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: We design a convenience way in plant research, which can classify the hibernal plants automatically. Different features related to this model will be taken into consideration, and other influenced facts will be included as well. The main points of the classification should be picked out and we will implement the system according to them and on the basis of Bayes. The Bayes Network is in use of coefficient learning so that we can get the advantages of adaptive learning and the best effects of classification through self-learning and adjusting parameters according to actual data. In this way, the problem of classifying hibernal plant automatically is solved and the result of experiment will be showed in the paper.

articleTitle: Teaching Information Study of Electronic Commerce Website Design Lesson
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Currently many colleges construct information-based teaching in Electronic Commerce website design lesson. This paper analyses the disadvantages of information-based teaching and the corresponding methods. At the same time this paper proposed a new teaching method named "teaching method with eight incremental steps". Finally it also summarizes the inevitable problems in information-based teaching. The information-based teaching inspires the studying interests of students, and improves the self-determination. Therefore, it enhances teaching quality and effectiveness of lesson.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Integrated PPI System
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: PPI, which means protein-protein interaction, is in use of many fields such as Pharmacology and Signal Transduction. PPI is formed by multiple proteins and play an important role. There are too many PPIs resources in used. Combination of the separated PPI systems is very promising as the data among different PPI resources are complementary. Integration of PPI of various resources can provide us more complete and more comprehensive information. In this paper, we design a PPI integration system which can get information from multiple various resources and then integrate the information together. The system is able to yield novel information for researchers to carry on further study on bio-information.

articleTitle: Network Optimization Method Based on Improved Quantum Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: To solve structure optimization problems of the information transmission networks, based on quantum genetic algorithm (QGA), the paper proposes an improved quantum genetic algorithm (IQGA). The core of the algorithm is to take full advantage of interference and entanglement of quantum states, through adopting the quantum gates rotation corner dynamic adjusting mechanism, quantum crossover and mutation operations, genetic operation parameters dynamic adaptive adjustment mechanism and solution elites control strategy. The algorithm has better performance in solving combinatorial optimization problems of the weak correlation between genes.

articleTitle: An Intergrative Pathways Aanalysis System with Different Resources
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Pathway, a chain of reactions associated with a particular metabolic process, plays a very important role in biological research. Now the researches of pathway are in full swing. There are many kinds of pathway resources, but these resources are not related. To a great extent, these resources are not consistent. But these pathway databases are complementing each other and supplement each other. Few people do about pathway database information integration of work. In this article, what we want to do is to seek a kind of method that can integrate pathway system from different resources. Using this method, we can easily get more detailed information of all participants in the pathway.

articleTitle: Inflation Forecasting Using Support Vector Regression
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Inflation forecasting plays an important role in monetary policy and daily life. This study focuses on developing an inflation support vector regression (SVR) model to forecast CPI. Money gap and CPI historical data are utilized to perform forecasts. Furthermore, grid search method is applied to select the parameters of SVR. In addition, this study examines the feasibility of applying SVR in inflation forecasting by comparing it with back-propagation neural network and linear regression. The result shows SVR provides a promising alternative to inflation prediction.

articleTitle: A Sender-Initiated Adaptive and Reliable Broadcast Scheme for VANET Safety Message
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Vehicular ad hoc network (VANET) is supposed to provide vehicles with reliable and efficient data transmissions for various applications, especially for the broadcast-based safety message. In this paper, we present a dedicated and reliable broadcast scheme for VANET safety message based on the use of positive acknowledgement from each message receiver. Moreover, our approach can be adaptive to the dynamic traffic density, which is highly important to design a broadcast scheme applicable to various traffic conditions. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme performs better on critical statistics we are concerned.

articleTitle: A Framework Based on Time and Space for Analyzing Denial of Service Attacks
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In recent years, people are paying more attention to formalizing and analysing Denial of Service attacks. But the analysis is almost exclusively focused on the computation cost. In this paper, we improve the cost-based framework proposed by Meadows and propose a new model to analyse the protocol's DoS resistance based on the time and space. Compared to the previous work, we give a more precise tolerance relation rather than merely binary in the improved framework. We analyse the Just Fast Keying (JFKi) protocol under our improved framework and explore the vulnerability which was found manually in the previous work.

articleTitle: Flexible Planes Extraction for Interactive-Friendly Multiview Stereo in Architectural Scenes
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes an automatic planes extraction approach to recover hypothesis planes of architectural scenes, being easily adopted in interactive-friendly multiview reconstruction systems. There exist many interactive scene reconstruction algorithms designed to model these real worlds, but they are very labor-intensive and difficult to verify whether the resulting 3D models are accurate or not. Motivated by the strongly piecewise planar property of architectural scenes, the hypothesis 3D planes can be generated automatically and flexibly in our work, being faster, more accurate and labor-saving than that of manually processing. Firstly, initial oriented points are reconstructed by using structure-from-motion and patch-based multiview stereo. Secondly, non-parametric density-based clustering technique is exploited to extract plane normal vectors without any presumption on the prior distributions of the normals of the planes, unlike famous Manhattan-world assumption. Then, the offsets of the planes can be estimated to specify the locations of the assumed 3D planes. Each group of the normal vectors and offset distances along the corresponding normals can determine certain candidates of plane structures. The obtained hypothesis planes are very beneficial to interactive-friendly multiview reconstruction with its efficiency and labor-saving, without measuring the sites, locating and digitizing architectural planes or converting existing CAD data.

articleTitle: Fog Effects Modeling and Removal for Real-Time Vision Applications
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Multiple light scattering, leading to blurring or loss of spatial resolution in dense fog regions, is not considered by previous imaging models. To better understand weather effects on vision and improve present defogging methods, this paper describes a new physics-based model, which can explain multiple scattering effects as well as the airlight and attenuation of reflections under fog conditions. Based on the model, an approach for estimating blurring effects of multiple scattering is proposed, using rough depth dependent weighted sum of multi-scale image convolutions. Then, we present a fast single image-based fog removal algorithm, in which blurring effects and airlight are estimated simultaneously with local minimum filter and two-scale Gaussian filters. Experimental results show that the algorithm can make impressive performance with real time implementation.

articleTitle: Multi-Central-Authority Attribute-Based Signature
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: In an Attribute-Based Signature (ABS), users sign messages with any predicate of their attributes issued from an attribute authority. Under this notion, a verifier verifies the signature that attests to a claim regarding the attributes the signer possesses rather than the identity of the individual who signed the message. ABS provides flexible access control policy and has many applications such as anonymous authentication. While in the real-world environment, more than one central authority and attribute authority usually co-operate to manage and issue different attributes for individuals. Unfortunately, to the best of our knowledge, no existing attribute-based signature scheme can be deployed in such setting. In this paper, we propose a Multi-Central-Authority Attribute-Based Signature (MCA-ABS) scheme corresponding to the setting with multiple Central Authorities (CAs) and Attribute Authorities (AAs). To produce a secret key of an attribute, the signer is required to obtain both id-related keys from all CAs and attributed-related key from the corresponding AA. In this way, the trust of a single CA is distributed to multiple CAs. Thus, the system remains secure, as long as there is one CA has not been compromised. We prove that the proposed MCA-ABS scheme is selectively unforgeable in the standard model and achieves perfect privacy. Compared with other existing ABS schemes, our scheme has shorter signature length and higher efficiency.

articleTitle: Combination of Prior Relations with Visual Information by Random Walk Model for Object Recognition
publicationTitle: 2012 Fourth International Symposium on Information Science and Engineering
abstract: Traditional object recognition methods in computer vision are almost based on just the visual features, which cannot perform well in a more complex circumstance. To attack this critical problem, this paper proposes a novel object recognition method which combines object recognition with the prior relations. During the training stage, structured presentation of the prior relations is applied through a hybrid graph which contains image similar sub-graph, semantic similar sub-graph and the relations between the two sub-graphs. A random walk model is then constructed according to the hybrid graph. During the recognition stage, a new testing image node is added to the random walk model. Then the relations between this node and the nodes in the random walk model are calculated. At last, random walks which start from the testing image node are performed at the random walk model. The probability rank provided by the result of random walks will serve as the recognition result of the testing image. Experimental results illustrate the validity and stronger recognition performance of the proposed method.
